prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: Capture every idea before it disappears
plan.description: A launch video for a note-taking app that captures ideas fast and keeps them easy to find. See how writing, organizing and searching work in one place.

beats.narration: Your best idea lasts a moment. Then it's gone. Buried in a sticky note, a screenshot, or a chat you will never scroll back to.

props.text: Your best idea is gone in seconds.

beats.narration: Meet our new note-taking app. Open it, type, and your thought is saved. No folders to pick. No buttons to hunt for. Just write.
Later, search finds it instantly. Notes link together on their own, and everything stays in sync across your phone, tablet and laptop.
Stop losing ideas. Start keeping them. Our note-taking app is here. Download it today and write down your next big thing.

props.title: Keep every idea.
props.subtitle: The new note-taking app is here
